subject: Request: One-off packaging exception (seat fractionation + onboarding credit) — Nexera Labs
messages:
From: Sofia Romero <sofia.romero@nexeralabs.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Packaging question & preliminary pricing ask

Hi Logan —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. A couple of procurement items we need to resolve before legal will push a PO: can Redwood accommodate fractional seats (we have 3 heavy users + 27 occasional users) and provide a one-time onboarding credit for a short pilot?

Ballpark: we're asking for an effective uplift of ~55% off list for the first 12 months if we commit to a 2-year term and include dedicated VPC. If that’s not possible, what flex do you have on seat bundling and onboarding credits?

Sofia
Sofia Romero | Head of Engineering Programs | Nexera Labs

Attachments: nexera_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Romero <sofia.romero@nexeralabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Packaging question & preliminary pricing ask

Hi Sofia —

Appreciate the clarity. We can support the technical side for seat fractionation (per-seat seat-license mapping + shared seats) but commercial needs an exception for fractional billing and the onboarding credit.

I’ve attached a short request packet and the commercial worksheet outlining the impact to list price and margin at several discount levels. Short answer: 55% off list for a 2-year dedicated VPC is outside standard guardrails. If Nexera can do a 3-year commit and agree to a usage floor (50% of forecast), I can escalate to get closer.

Next step: I’ll route an internal exception memo to Sales Leadership + Finance for VP/CFO signoff. Can you confirm the preferred start date and whether legal needs a redline on SLA now?

Thanks —
Logan\Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: nexera_seat_fractionation_request.pdf, commercial-exception-worksheet.xlsx

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T08:42:00Z
Subject: INTERNAL: Nexera Labs — exception request for fractional seats + onboarding credit (requesting VP/CFO signoff)

Team — moving Nexera to an exec escalation. Key facts below and attached packet. Need VP/CFO approval to proceed with the customer ask.

Summary: Nexera Labs requests fractional seat billing model (3 dedicated heavy seats + 27 shared seats across product teams) + one-time onboarding credit. They’re asking for ~55% off list year 1 on a 2-year term for Dedicated VPC. Proposed compromise: 3-year term, 40% off year 1 (stepped down to 30% year 2 and 20% year 3) + onboarding credit equal to 1 month of committed spend, and a 50% usage floor for year 1. Net present value modeled in attachment.

Why this is important: Strategic biotech prospect in clinical document ingestion — strong references, plan to expand to 5x seats within 24 months. Competes with a larger vendor offering bundled discounts but with worse latency and no private deployment option.

Commercial impact: At the 40/30/20 step plan with 3-year commit + 50% floor, projected unit margin is ~18% before onboarding credit. Without the usage floor, margin falls below 10% in year 1. We’d need approval for the fractional billing concession and to waive the standard minimum seat granularity.

Ask: Markus — please sign off for commercial exception (fractional billing + onboarding credit) and approve the step-down discount schedule. Marissa — recommend approval conditioned on a signed 3-year commitment and 50% usage floor. Jordan — please confirm routing to finance for revenue recognition treatment of the onboarding credit.

Attachments: commercial-exception-worksheet.xlsx, signed-sla-draft.docx, nexera_seat_fractionation_request.pdf

Thanks,
Logan

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T14:20:00Z
Subject: Re: INTERNAL: Nexera Labs — exception request for fractional seats + onboarding credit (requesting VP/CFO signoff)

Logan / Marissa —

Read the packet. I’m prepared to approve a conditional exception with guardrails. My decision: approve the proposed step-down schedule (40/30/20) and fractional billing as a one-time operational concession provided we get all of the following in writing before signing:

- 3-year committed term (no early termination without renegotiation)
- 50% minimum usage floor year 1 (penalty schedule in worksheet)
- Prepayment for first two quarters (applies to onboarding credit offset)
- Redwood reserves the right to revert customer to standard seat granularity after year 1 if usage patterns create disproportional operational overhead

Finance note: Jordan, please confirm that the onboarding credit will be treated as a contra-revenue amortized over the 12-month pilot window and provide guidance if prepayment alters recognition.

Marissa — please draft the email to legal and procurement with the conditions and request a final PO by 2026-12-08. I’ll sign the memo once procurement language is in place.

-Markus
VP, Sales (acting CFO sign-off authority for commercial exceptions)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Romero <sofia.romero@nexeralabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T16:03:00Z
Subject: Nexera Labs — approved exception (conditions)

Sofia —

Good news: Sales leadership has conditionally approved the packaging exception. High level terms we can accept (subject to legal/procurement signoff):

- 3-year committed term
- Step-down discount: 40% (Y1), 30% (Y2), 20% (Y3) applied to list for Dedicated VPC
- One-time onboarding credit equal to one month of committed spend, netted and amortized over the first 12 months
- Fractional seat model enabled for pilot (3 heavy seats + 27 shared seats) with explicit operational handoff and potential reversion clause
- 50% usage floor in year 1; failure to meet floor triggers shortfall billing per worksheet
- Prepayment: first two quarters invoiced at contract signature; offsets onboarding credit

Can you confirm acceptance of these conditions and confirm PO timeline, and whether legal needs a redline of the SLA? Once we have confirmation I’ll circulate the signed exception memo.

Thanks —
Logan
